sentences.text: It measured about 6 meters in length and featured a large skull that likely bore unique ornaments instead of horns.
Evidence from the skull suggests Indosaurus may have had horns over its eyes, though all such fossil evidence has since been lost.
It holds the distinction of being the first majungasaurine discovered by science.
The animal was closely related to the strange South American predator Carnotaurus.
The holotype, which is the specimen the species is based on, was found between 1917 and 1919 in Jabalpur, India, by Charles Alfred Matley.
Dietary habits likely included sauropods such as Isisaurus and Jainosaurus, which coexisted with the predator.
Fossils were recovered from the Lameta Formation, where rocks were deposited in fluvial or lacustrine conditions.
Originally assigned to Allosauridae, the genus is now considered a member of the Abelisauridae family.
Indosaurus lived in what is now India between 69 and 66 million years ago during the Late Cretaceous.
The time range for the animal is estimated from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
Some paleontologists speculate that Indosuchus, Lametasaurus, and Indosaurus should be considered nomina dubia.
It is debated whether Orthogoniosaurus is the same animal as Indosaurus but based on different material.
